visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene is set in a bright, modern cafe with white walls and various framed artworks. A man in a dark denim shirt sits in a yellow armchair at a small white marble table, calmly drinking from a Starbucks paper cup. A woman in a white knit sweater and black shorts stands beside him, sweeping the floor near his feet with a red plastic broom. (2) The woman lifts the front hem of her white sweater and drapes it over the man's head and shoulders, momentarily covering his face while he continues to sip his drink. (3) She moves to the wall and uses a blue microfiber cloth to wipe the glass of a framed painting depicting a city scene. (4) The woman sprays a clear liquid from a bottle onto the man's hands while he holds his cup, then sprays a large circular metallic wall sculpture behind him. (5) She vigorously rubs the top of the man's head with the blue cloth as if polishing a piece of furniture, while he looks ahead with a slight smile. (6) In the final scene, the man is lying flat on his back on the floor beneath the table, pointing one finger upward at the seated woman who remains in her chair opposite his original position.
